summary: Delta Point enclosed tower, Shasta Co., CA (Shasta NF): manned by Ray Norberg in June 1945 per The Dunsmuir News; FFLA lists it Gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: FFLA's California list marks it Gone. No source gives a removal date or method.

events.note: June 29, 1945 item in The Dunsmuir News (as quoted on Forest Lookouts): manned by Ray Norberg, described as an ex-cowpuncher from Wyoming

evidence.supports: manned by Ray Norberg, an ex-cowpuncher from Wyoming (The Dunsmuir News)
evidence.quote: Delta Point is manned (yes, a man) by eagle-eyed Ray Norberg, an ex-cowpuncher from Wyoming.

evidence.supports: Shasta County; kind enclosed tower; status Gone; coordinates 40.96373, -122.41212
evidence.quote: Delta Point Shasta 40.96373 -122.41212 Encl. Tower Gone

evidence.supports: Shasta National Forest listed for Delta Point; Shasta-Trinity National Forest listed for Girard Ridge on the same county page
Girard Ridge listed under Shasta-Trinity National Forest

notes_for_editor: Brief matches the sources (Shasta County, enclosed tower, Gone). Only one dated item was found (June 1945 staffing, quoted secondhand from The Dunsmuir News). Forest naming differs within the Forest Lookouts county list (Shasta NF for Delta Point, Shasta-Trinity NF for Girard Ridge); the story reports this rather than resolving it. Unlinked lead, not used: a 2018 Delta Fire near Lakehead (CAL FIRE incident page, seen only in a search snippet, roughly 3 km from these coordinates) shares the name. No source ties it to the lookout, so it is left out. No FFLOS or NHLR entry found; no photos found.
